body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ‘SDC-K60/DMB’ a T-DMB 6M digital camera during KES 2006. It features ISO 1600, 6M CCD, x3 optical zoom, and 3-inch 16:9 wide LCD.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
